plan.title: SMS one-time code login
plan.summary: Add passwordless login for policyholders using a one-time code sent by SMS, with rate limiting and audit logging.
assumptions: An SMS gateway account already exists
Existing customer accounts have verified mobile numbers

phases.name: Discovery
phases.goal: Agree flows, edge cases and security rules

phases.name: Testing
phases.goal: Prove it works and is safe

risks: SMS delivery delays in some regions
openQuestions: How long should a code stay valid, and how many wrong tries lock the account?
Does password login stay available, or does SMS replace it?
outOfScope: Email or authenticator-app codes as a fallback
Changing the mobile number on an account

costs.item: Security review of the login flow
